program_name: Diploma in Games Design and Animation

fees.notes: StudyMalaysia course page: international fees RM57,685. MSU official programme pages publish Malaysian fees only; no official international fee schedule available. Source: https://studymalaysia.com/what/course/MSU/0005990/ (accessed 2026-09-18).

requirements.general: At least THREE (3) Credits at SPM/SPMV level and a Pass in Pendidikan Seni (Arts Education) or Lukisan Kejuruteraan (Engineering Drawing); OR PTPL Computer Science Certificate; OR Equivalent qualification recognized by MSU Senate. Candidates who did not take Pendidikan Seni or Lukisan Kejuruteraan must pass MSU’s interview, drawing test, or portfolio evaluation.
